Dr. Eleanor Voss  
Professor of Electrical Engineering  
Greenfield Institute of Technology  
e.voss@ginstitute.edu  

Ritika Malhotra 91 joined my embedded systems course as a part-time student while working at HealthSense Devices. Though our interactions were limited to classroom settings, her contributions to class projects and discussions revealed a deep technical acumen and pragmatic approach to problem-solving.  

Ritika’s expertise in C/C++ and RTOS design stands out. She led firmware development for a critical medical device, reducing boot time by 22% through optimized memory management. Her work on hardware-software integration for a wearable ECG monitor resolved latency issues, enabling real-time data sampling with 99.8% reliability. These projects showcased her ability to balance performance constraints with safety-critical requirements.  

During a collaborative project on a remote patient monitoring system, Ritika took ownership of the RTOS configuration. She redesigned task scheduling to prioritize life-support functions, ensuring compliance with ISO 13485 standards. Her decision to implement a modular firmware architecture allowed rapid updates, cutting deployment cycles by 30% without compromising stability.  

Ritika’s work ethic is equally notable. She consistently prioritizes reliability over expedience, often staying late to debug edge cases. Her ability to distill complex systems into clear, actionable solutions makes her a rare asset in healthtech.  

Should you have further questions, please contact me directly.  
Sincerely,  
Dr. Eleanor Voss
